newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysian palm oil surges at close.
newsitem.headline: Malaysian palm oil surges at close.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL
PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices closed firmer on late buying aided by the firmness in the cash market. Trading was active. Sentiment was also helped by good local fundamentals.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL - Prices also firmed with buying from refiners and interest was seen among nearby months.
Traders said bullish December crop estimates from private forecaster Ivan Wong continued to underpin sentiment.
On Tuesday, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said Malaysia's palm oil output in December is estimated to have fallen by 17.4 percent to 630,000 tonnes from November.
He put end-December palm oil stocks at 805,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 955,965 tonnes at end-November.
Exports in December is estimated at 660,000 tonnes against PORLA's 632,441 tonnes in November.
Third month March futures closed up two ringgit at 1,270 ringgit a tonne after trading between 1,263 and 1,278 ringgit.
There was active buying in the spot physical crude palm oil, traders said. Jan (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,317.50 against bids at 1,312.50, after trading from 1,305 and 1,315.
Jan (central) was offered at 1,312.50 and bid at 1,307.50, with trades at between 1,300 and 1,310.
Feb (south) saw offers at 1,317.50 with bids at 1,312.50, and traded from 1,305 to 1,315. Feb (central) was offered at 1,312.50 with bids at 1,305.
Among refined products, Jan RBD palm oil was offered at $552.50 a tonne FOB Malaysia, and Feb/Mar at $547.50. Feb was traded at $545 and $547.
Jan RBD palm olein saw offers at $585, Feb at $582.50 and Mar at $580. Feb was traded at $580 and $582.50, and Mar at $575.
Jan RBD palm stearin was offered at $422.50 and Feb at $425. Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $295.
